publicReleaseNotes: Oncall 0.2.0 makes local startup a single `rer dev` command with a Finish setup page, and offers `rer demo` for a throwaway local trial. Imported schedules can be made live in Schedules with an explicit administrator mapping; an immediate (0-minute) Opsgenie first escalation step is stored as 1 minute with the difference stated. Owner email sign-in handles stale installation cookies, restored owners can explicitly map an archived administrator, and Schedules shows now/next and its named time zone at the top. `rer doctor` explains the verification-browser prerequisite. This release adds no migrations. Hosted Oncall stays on hold and paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager authoritative.

agentUpdateInstructions: To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling: run `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop` in the old checkout. Install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (open a new terminal if instructed), or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`. Then, on main, run `git pull --ff-only` followed by `rer dev`. There are no new migrations in 0.2.0; keep all 18 applied migrations unchanged. The update preserves authored data, owner and password accounts; do not reset to upgrade. Back up first: while the old servers are stopped, `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` can export 0.1.0; later versions use `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`. Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For updates after 0.1.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop` before pulling, then run `rer dev`. No hosted deployment is needed. For hosted coordination, configure remote sign-in mail and run rer deploy with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link. Update an existing hosted installation with rer deploy, preserving its owner and data. Remove with rer deploy --remove --yes and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
